$comment: Phase 4B. Two additive schema changes that let a deal derive Industry from its linked CRM organization's NAICS: (1) a reverse lookup cr664_Organization on cr664_clientrelationship -> cr664_crmorganization so a deal (deal -> cr664_Client -> client relationship) can reach the org's NAICS code; (2) an admin-managed mapping table cr664_naicsindustrymap (NAICS sector -> deal industry label). Additive, create-missing-only. Keep the seed mappings in sync with scripts/seed-naics-industry-map.mjs. Used by create-deal-industry-crm-naics.ps1.

relationships.note: Reverse link so a bridged client relationship points back at the CRM organization it mirrors. Populated by the (default-off) org-link path in bridgeOrgToClientRelationship.
